# podman-mcp — LLM Index

Version 3.5.0 | Ports 11112/11113 | FastMCP 3.5 | 9 portmanteau tools (70+ operations)

## Quick Start

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/sandraschi/podman-mcp
cd podman-mcp
uv sync
.\start.ps1
```
Opens dashboard on `http://127.0.0.1:11112`. Backend API on `11113`, MCP on `/mcp`.

## Tools

All tools use portmanteau pattern (discriminator-based operations):

| Tool | Ops | Covers |
|------|-----|--------|
| `manage_containers` | 12 | CRUD, logs, stats, exec, files, resources |
| `manage_pods` | 6 | Pod lifecycle (Podman-unique) |
| `manage_images` | 6 | Pull, build, search, delete |
| `manage_system` | 14 | Machine lifecycle, generate_systemd, volumes, networks |
| `manage_compose` | 7 | Up/down/ps/logs/build/config/debug |
| `manage_backup` | 8 | Save/load images, volumes, containers, compose |
| `manage_migrate` | 7 | Docker↔Podman porting |
| `manage_agentic` | 5 | Deploy, cleanup, diagnose, rollback, health_sweep |
| `manage_health` | 3 | Container analysis, system overview, recommendations |

## Webapp — 13 pages

Dashboard, Containers, Pods, Images, Volumes, Networks, Compose, Migrate (Docker↔Podman), AI Command, MCP Tools, Event Logs, Help, Settings.

Dashboard shows: rootless badge, daemonless badge, Pods native badge, 5 KPI cards, 4 categorized error states with step-by-step fix instructions.

## Key Files

- Full reference: [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt)
- Tool registration: `src/podmanmcp/tool_registration.py`
- REST endpoints: `src/podman_mcp/web.py`
- Podman CLI bridge: `src/podmanmcp/podman_context.py`
- Frontend router: `web_sota/src/App.tsx`

## Configuration

| Env | Default | Purpose |
|-----|---------|---------|
| `MCP_TRANSPORT` | stdio | stdio / http |
| `MCP_PORT` | 11113 | HTTP port |
| `PODMAN_CMD` | auto | CLI path |
| `OLLAMA_BASE_URL` | localhost:11434 | LLM provider |

Full list: [.env.example](.env.example)
